title: Beach Read
overview: When an idealistic romance novelist and a cynical literary fiction writer—rival authors with dramatically opposing worldviews and a serious case of writer's block—unexpectedly find themselves living next door to each other in a small Lake Michigan beach town for the summer, they strike an unlikely bet to swap genres and the lines between fiction and romance begin to blur.

title: The Legend of Zelda
overview: A live-action adaptation of Nintendo's Legend of Zelda video game series.

title: Everybody Wants to F*ck Me
overview: Adam strives to present as a sensitive feminist but behind the facade he’s a serial womaniser. After a one night stand with a mysterious stranger leaves him suddenly irresistible, Adam’s dream quickly turns into a nightmare.

title: Thank You Charlotte
overview: Film focuses on the relationship between a child from Turkiye, so less than 10-years-old, and a French mother which she adopted him. It’s about the relationship of different worlds.

title: Caution - A Noah Cash Film
overview: Upcoming Noah Cash feature film, plot under wraps.

title: THE REWIND
overview: The Rewind is a time-travel action movie about a man, Russel, who wakes up one day to discover that he is in a world where time plays in reverse except for him. As he tries to figure out what happened, he realizes that someone has stolen a watch that messes up time and reality. He teams up with a group of people to try to find the person who stole the watch and fix time. Along the way, he discovers the past and has to come to terms with his life and relationships.

title: Bad Fairies
overview: Hidden beneath the streets of modern London exists a secret magical world powered by an ancient code that fairies have followed for centuries. But when a fearless gang of rule-breaking fairies accidentally transforms an ordinary tween into a fairy, they uncover a far bigger problem: the magic system itself is failing. With their world on the brink of collapse, the group's toughest renegade hero (voiced by Cynthia Erivo) must forge an unlikely alliance with the very human they transformed, embarking on a race against time through both London and the hidden magical realm. Together, they'll discover that saving magic may require breaking every rule in the book -proving that sometimes doing a little bad is the only way to do a whole lot of good.

title: Twisted
overview: As the heir to her parents’ legendary pizzeria, Angelina, a feisty Italian teenager, fears breaking tradition might break their hearts. As her desire to break free grows, so do her lies. But when her web of deceit spins out of control, she opens a portal to a wondrous and treacherous mythical underworld putting her family in grave danger. To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
overview: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

title: The Loneliest Man in Town
overview: Blues musician Al Cook lives in an apartment filled with memories. Outside, the world carries on without him. But when his home is slated for demolition, out of the ruins of his existence, a long-forgotten dream suddenly resurfaces.

title: Beyond the Apex: Part II
overview: After his season-ending crash at the Belgium Grand Prix, Mikal Springer is cut from Formula 1 and is forced to race in another series. Dealing with the trauma of his taste of death, and now a lack of passion due to burnout, he struggles with whether to keep racing or to call it quits.
